title: Aortic regurgitation valve replacement
scope: Generic class mechanism in representative anatomy. The anatomy, device shape and positions shown are representative of this class; they are not measured on a specific patient or population, and not a specific product. Schematic, not to scale; poses do not predict clinical fit, deformation, performance or flow.
stageLabel: Schematic · representative anatomy · not to scale
attribution: Whole-heart context adapted from Toronto Heart Atlas by Azad Mashari, Joshua Qua Hiansen, Mini Pakkal, Eitan Aziza, Ryan Ramos, Sachin Khargie and Massimiliano Meineri (CC BY 4.0). Display smoothing, vessel continuations and edits for readability are modifications. Detailed tissue shells, defects, device shapes and positions are representative schematics. They are not measured on a specific patient or population, and are not segmented tissue or clinical simulations.

designs.label: Leaflet-engaging frame
designs.summary: Conceptual external arms mark engagement with native leaflet tissue.

designs.label: Flared engaging frame
designs.summary: A taller flared alternative with the same conceptual engagement relationship.

states.label: 1. Anatomy context
states.note: Representative sectioned shell and approximate junction; no native leaflet reconstruction.

states.label: 2. Replacement open
states.note: Representative open replacement leaflets; support frame fixed.

states.label: 3. Replacement closed
states.note: Representative closure pose; support frame unchanged. No flow or seal calculation.

views.label: Whole heart
views.title: Locate the treatment region
views.lesson: Use the highlighted region to orient the enlarged views.

views.label: LV and aorta
views.title: See the valve in its regional setting
views.lesson: The left ventricle, aortic root and ascending aorta come from a real heart model and are opened along their length. The outflow tract leads up to the valve site, where the root widens into its sinuses. The valve position shown is representative and is not measured on a specific patient or population.

views.label: Local access direction
views.title: Follow the approach toward the valve
views.lesson: The arrow comes down the ascending aorta toward the valve, as in an approach from the aorta. The complete route is not shown.

views.label: Mechanism section
views.title: See the tissue–device relationship
views.lesson: Conceptual engagement arms supplement a generic frame around a representative native valve level.

views.label: Oblique detail
views.title: Understand depth and attachment
views.lesson: An oblique view separates the near surface, device and supporting tissue.

views.label: Face view
views.title: Look along the opening
views.lesson: The face view complements the section. All poses and proportions are representative, not measured.

location.label: TREATMENT LOCATION
location.body: The enlarged marker indicates the treatment location for orientation; it is not an implant.

junction.label: APPROXIMATE JUNCTION
junction.body: Conceptual engagement arms supplement a generic frame around a representative native valve level. The marked level is approximate, not a segmented annulus.

tissue.label: REPRESENTATIVE TISSUE
tissue.body: The smooth sectioned shell is representative and is not measured on a specific patient or population. It is not a segmented myocardial or vessel wall.

frame.label: FIXED SUPPORT FRAME
frame.body: The generic lattice stays fixed when the prosthetic leaflets open and close. Mesh spacing and proportions are representative, not measured.

leaflet.label: PROSTHETIC LEAFLETS
leaflet.body: The thin leaflets shown are representative and open within the same support. Motion, flow and tissue contact are not calculated.

special.label: CONCEPTUAL ENGAGEMENT
special.body: The broad outer arms indicate a class-level engagement idea; contact and retention are not calculated.

region_lv.label: LEFT VENTRICLE
region_lv.body: The left ventricle narrows into the outflow tract that leads to the aortic valve.

region_root.label: AORTIC ROOT
region_root.body: The aortic root has three rounded bulges, the sinuses, around the valve level and continues into the ascending aorta.

region_aorta.label: ASCENDING AORTA
region_aorta.body: The ascending aorta continues upward from the aortic root.

region_valve.label: VALVE LEVEL
region_valve.body: This marks the valve level at the base of the root. In the replacement states the selected generic valve is shown here. The valve position shown is representative and is not measured on a specific patient or population.

region_access.label: APPROACH DIRECTION
region_access.body: The arrow shows an approach down the ascending aorta toward the valve. It does not show the complete route or a delivery device.
